## mddeck v0.1.5

Patch release that fixes two npm-install runtime errors in **0.1.4**.

### Fixed

- **`Cannot find module '…@marp-team/marpit/plugin.js'` when running `bin/mddeck.js` from an npm-installed `@machine-w/mddeck-cli`.** The vendored marpit plugin shims in `packages/core/src/{marpp,marpit}_plugin.ts` used a hardcoded relative path that assumed a workspace install layout. Replaced with a normal `import '@marp-team/marpit/plugin.js'` so Node / esbuild resolve it the same way in any install context.
- **`ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` from `require('@machine-w/mddeck-core')`.** The `exports["."]` map only declared `import` and `types` conditions, so CJS-style resolution fell through with no match. Added `default` (and re-ordered `types` first) so both ESM `import` and CJS `require` resolve to `dist/index.js`.

### Notes

- 0.1.4 was published with the same two bugs and **could not be unpublished** — npm blocks unpublish from granular access tokens via its 2FA policy. 0.1.4 has been deprecated on npm with a pointer to 0.1.5.
- Public API is unchanged. Consumers on `^0.1.2` will resolve to **0.1.5** on next install.

### Install

```bash
npm install --save-dev @machine-w/mddeck-cli
# or
npx @machine-w/mddeck-cli presentation.md -o slides.html
```

### What's in the box

- `@machine-w/mddeck-core` — the library
- `@machine-w/mddeck-cli` — the `mddeck` command (HTML / PDF / watch / server)
- `mddeck-slides` — VS Code extension (unchanged in this release)
